desc: Bulldog's Elite Rifle Case is constructed of a heavy-duty water resistant nylon outer shell with a heat resistant soft inner lining. The case also has an extra thick, 2.25" total impact resistant padding, a deluxe padded shoulder strap with all metal swivels, and quilted outer panels which provides a modern look. Its exterior features three zippered pockets and large custom zippers and zipper pulls, while its unique shape works with bi-pods and large scopes. This model is compatible with 44" long rifle or shotgun.
